title: Homes and work
summary: Colonists need a home with room, and they make buildings work better.
text:
**Homes:** the Civilian Center houses six. Past that, build a **Habitat Block**: six more each, no pods. People in an unpowered home are unhappier.

**Work:** colonists staff the buildings that have room for workers. Each worker present makes the building work better: depots mine more, Hydroponics grows more, turrets hit harder, the bay and the lab go faster. A specialist in the right building adds more:

- **Engineers**: depots, deep mines, factories
- **Botanists**: Hydroponics, the Seed Bank
- **Medics**: the Civilian Center, the Med Bay
- **Technicians**: the Tech Lab, solar, shields
- **Security**: turrets

Output follows the shift: buildings work best while their people are there. Some research also needs a specialist living in the colony.
